structure: CSharp EmitArrayExchange and Native emitExchange evaluate receiver and indices, check both unsigned bounds, branch past mutation for equal indices, and exchange complete element representations using declared type/alignment. BitSet is a fixed inline owner; mutation reads/writes the original slot or mutable borrow, while count/contains read its current representation.
branches: Array exchange checks both indices before any element load/store; equal-index branch skips the swap. Native distinguishes local versus mutable-borrow/projection storage. BitSet mutation dispatches OR versus inverted-AND; reads select the dynamic word; count masks only a partial final word before ctpop. Int signed negatives fail bounds in both paths (CSharp unsigned i32 test before zero extension; Native sign extension plus nonnegative/unsigned limit checks).
logic: Paired original runtime outputs and allocation/release counts: nested-owned exchange7, integer local/mut/if exchange1, fixed BitSet0. Counts cover multiple words, full64 and tail63; contains covers readonly receivers and a dynamic index. Preserve original851 LLVM contains2 and not-contains3.
diagnostics: No diagnostic or expected output changes. This unit does not claim execution of the separate full indexed-owned-exchange9 contract, all invalid index diagnostics, entire source phases or platform support.
